36.t: The price of play, ticket wins and other settings can be made in Set Mode. To enter the Set Mode, open the coin door, press and hold the Select Button and slide the test switch ON. The item number and contents are displayed in the Score and Target displays. To advance to the next item press the select button. The contents can be changed by pressing the service button. To store the new values advance to the next step, or slide the test switch OFF to return to normal game mode. The test switch must always be in the “OFF” position for normal game mode.
NOTE: The price of play on this game is set within the Cashflow Coin Mech. Ensure that the Coin/Game options (1 & 2) are both set to 1.
